entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support roslyn-language-server tool installation on FreeBSD #86296
  • Visual Studio Razor numeric parameters ignore Number color classification #86295
    Backlog
  • Remove stackalloc/skiplocalsinit from unsafev2 for now #86293
  • Loose quotes in razor component attributes crashes app on startup, requesting a compile time error #86289

Closed

  • Need an API to get the 'iteration type' of a type. #77926
    Backlog
  • On Windows ARM64, VBCSCompiler can hang forever in TryParseFileTypeName's shared Regex #86274
    18.14
  • Calls to extension properties for `readonly struct` treat setters as mutating the foreach loop variable #82249
    18.8
  • Extensions: consider adjusting receiver requirements for extension members #79451
    Backlog
  • Language server: deleting many source files stalls every request that needs the project's compilation, about 1 s per deleted file #86236

PullRequests

Created

  • Plan removal of the unsafe v2 stackalloc/SkipLocalsInit restriction #86294
  • Unsafe evolution: fix unsafe expression diagnostics #86292
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix implementation of IsEffectivelyReadOnly API for reduced generic extension methods #86291
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ref return emit #86290
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • add SemanticModel.GetIterationType and GetAsyncIterationType #86175
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs API Review, Next
  • Introduce a new pool for large Razor tag helper collection lists #86217
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Don't report CA1704 for parameters named _ #86288
    Area-Analyzers, Community, Next
  • Fix condition in target setting HotReloadBrowserToolsEnabled #86287
    Next
  • Treat extension methods for value types with ByVal and RefReadonly receivers as effectively readonly #86255
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Handle BOM in file-based app script #86261
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File, Next
  • Avoid compilation stalls when source files are deleted #86286
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Retry replacement failure with adjacent temp file #86210
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3125511 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Find and remove unnecessary Razor using directives for dotnet format #86283
    Community, Needs API Review, Area-Razor
  • Fix Razor rename issue with using aliases #86243
    Area-Razor
  • File-based apps: go-to-definition for `#:include`, `#:project`, and `#:ref` directives #84756
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • [main] Update FBA sources #86260
  • Fix Generate Constructor crash when inspecting properties in referenced projects #86021
    VSCode
  • Caching compiler: replay diagnostics #86263
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86112
  • Parse `[...] = x` in with initializers as an indexer #85798
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Support unsafe v2 in declaration generation #86258
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86186
  • [release/stable] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86256
